name: io.github.Servosity/mimecast-mcp
title: Mimecast MCP
description: Explain a held or blocked Mimecast message in one verdict, triage the hold queue, trace phish clicks

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Mimecast API 2.0 application.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of your Mimecast API 2.0 application.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_ACCOUNT_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Delegate access account code for the classic endpoints.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Regional API gateway, for example https://uk-api.services.mimecast.com.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Regional OAuth token endpoint; set it with MIMECAST_BASE_URL.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. OAuth scope for the token request; leave blank for none.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to Mimecast.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Binds the MCP server to one saved client profile.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses.

environmentVariables.name: MIMECAST_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
